QuestInfo.name: [Papulatus] The Way to Papulatus
QuestInfo.0: #p2041023# claims to know how to get rid of Papulatus. Listen to her.
QuestInfo.1: #p2041023# says you need the #t4031179# to encounter Papulatus. Get the necessary item from #p2041023#. \r\n
QuestInfo.2: You got instructions on how to find and defeat #p2041023#.\r\n

0.0: Well, dearie me. Listen close. Get rid of #rThanatos#k the Gatekeeper of the #bForgotten Passage#k to get the #t4031172:#, which will let you enter the Origin of Clocktower.
0.1: Once there, you might be surprised at how quiet it is. But, if you close the Dimensional Crack, #o8500002# will suddenly appear in a furious frenzied rage! So, you ready to go?

yes.0: Now, where did I put it? Just give me a second to find it...

no.0: I get it. You need some time to talk yourself into it.

1.0: Here's the #b#t4031179:##k. Use it to close up the Dimensional Crack that #o8500002# is hiding in. Trust me, that'll get his attention.
